header: IN THE HIGH COURT OF SINDH,
DATE ORDER WITH SIGNATURE OF JUDGE
None present for the applicant nor any intimation is received. Same was
body: the position on the last date of hearing, which shows that counsel for the applicant has lost interest in pursuing the matter. Therefore, this Court has no option but to dismiss the instant Criminal Transfer Application for non-prosecution. Accordingly, it stands dismissed for non-prosecution alongwith listed application.
